messages:
nina (Billing): Heads up - Azure Marketplace invoice AZ-2026-2109 shows reseller NorthGate billed in EUR but our contract is USD. Invoice total EUR 56,700 appears as USD 56,700 on partner portal, causing a ~€8,400 FX delta. Anyone seen this before?
carlos (Revenue Ops): That smells like a portal export bug where they forget currency code. Do we have the original invoice PDF or XML?
nina (Billing): PDF in /finance/marketplace/inbound/AZ-2026-2109.pdf. Key header: Currency: EUR. But settlement file used currency_code=USD.
yvonne (Partner Ops): azure-bot, did ingestion map a currency override for AZ-2026-2109?
azure-bot: Ingestion AZ-2026-2109 processed 2026-06-02T08:41Z. Detected currency header mismatch: invoice_currency=EUR vs settlement_currency=USD. Action: FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW.
carlos (Revenue Ops): Thanks. Two paths: 1) request corrected settlement CSV from partner with EUR values, or 2) if partner confirms USD billing, we need evidence of contract amendment. Financial impact ~€8,400 (~$9,200). Above credit threshold -> manager approval needed for interim adjustment.
nina (Billing): We haven't booked revenue yet; it's in pending. Recommend we hold settlement until partner confirms. Also ask partner for FX rate used if they insist USD.
yvonne (Partner Ops): I'll ping NorthGate rep now. Suggested message: "We observed AZ-2026-2109 has invoice currency EUR but settlement CSV shows USD equivalence. Please confirm the intended billing currency and provide corrected settlement file or contract amendment." OK to send?
carlos (Revenue Ops): Send it. Also ask for timestamped proof of rate if they claimed USD conversion.
nyvonne (Partner Ops): Sent at 08:47Z. Rep replied: "internal export bug, will resend settlement CSV with EUR and euro amounts. Expect within 48h"
nina (Billing): Great. Please attach amended CSV to /finance/marketplace/corrections/AZ-2026-2109-eur.csv when received and mark for manual review.
carlos (Revenue Ops): If amended arrives, we'll re-run reconciliation and book settlement. If not received in 48h, escalate to partner-ops lead.
yvonne (Partner Ops): noted. Marking as open until corrected file attached.
nina (Billing): Filing ticket MT-6028 for audit trail. Will update thread when file lands
